svg.title: Synchronous update time
svg.desc: Engine remeasurement on 2026-11-14 against the reconstructed intermediate baseline. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. SVG · 12 reshaping lenses: previous median 33.8027 ms, range 32.8159 to 34.543; current median 11.9709 ms, range 11.4838 to 13.658. SVG · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 56.7523 ms, range 55.9485 to 59.1903; current median 22.6241 ms, range 21.9764 to 26.4724. SVG · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 0.198907 ms, range 0.185484 to 0.234302; current median 0.19116 ms, range 0.182162 to 0.197268. WebGL · 24 reshaping lenses: previous median 6.95375 ms, range 6.82042 to 7.1025; current median 6.97792 ms, range 6.87708 to 7.4473. WebGL · 24 cached movement lenses: previous median 0.243154 ms, range 0.143568 to 0.298333; current median 0.246667 ms, range 0.166805 to 0.285062. 5 trials/build · median of trial means. Async decode and GPU completion excluded
